lines.text: He likes me? He ignores me?

data.define: When someone's words and actions don't match.

example.text: He sends mixed signals about the trip.

hook.text: He likes me? He ignores me?

publish.title: What does "mixed signals" mean?
publish.value: Mixed signals = Confusing messages from someone. Example: "He sends mixed signals about the trip." (casual English).
